meta.promptFormat: Add {prompt} to this image, fitting the scene's perspective, lighting and surroundings naturally. Change nothing else.
meta.promptFormatImperative: {prompt}. Fit the result to the scene's perspective, lighting and surroundings naturally, and change nothing else.
meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen-Image 2511)' template (2026-10): UNETLoader → ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1 → CFGNorm 1.0 → KSampler euler/simple, denoise 1, 40 steps at CFG 4 (Comfy's own note accepts 20 steps); FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod index_timestep_zero on both conditionings; FluxKontextImageScale brings the input to the model's ~1 MP working size. Inpainting is added with core nodes: the mask PNG is loaded, turned into a MASK and applied with SetLatentNoiseMask, so only the selected area is regenerated. The Lightning variants (`fill-lightning-8`, `fill-lightning-4`) add the Apache-2.0 LoRA after CFGNorm.
meta.creator: Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Fills the selection with 40 steps: slowest, most careful
